paras.text: i. A stakeholder is any person or organization who has a direct or indirect interest in the project.

paras.text: ii. System maintenance is performed to gather the requirements of the proposed system.

paras.pashto: ii. د سیسټم ساتنه د وړاندیز شوي سیسټم د اړتیاوو د راټولولو لپاره کېږي.

paras.text: iii. The how, when, what type of questions are answered in the planning phase of SDLC.

paras.text: iv. The three architectures i.e. algorithms, pseudo code and flowcharts are used in the implementation phase of SDLC.
